description: Official GovInfo Statutes at Large PDFs captured for verification of final appropriation clauses; separate from historical USC build manifests.

captures.needle: the Attorney General may transfer to, or reimburse
captures.start: Provided further, That the Attorney General may transfer to, or reimburse, any other department, agency,
captures.end: in connection with the administration and enforcement of said laws;
captures.paragraphText: Provided further, That the Attorney General may transfer to, or reimburse, any other department, agency, or office of Federal, State, or local governments, funds in such amounts as may be necessary for salaries and expenses incurred by them in rendering authorized assistance to the Department of Justice in connection with the administration and enforcement of said laws;
captures.paragraphBoundaryStart: Provided further, That the Attorney General may transfer to, or reimburse, any other department, agency,
captures.paragraphBoundaryEnd: in connection with the administration and enforcement of said laws;

captures.needle: employment of interpreters in the Immigration and Naturalization Service
captures.start: Provided further, That provisions of law prohibiting or restricting the employment of aliens in the Government service shall not apply
captures.end: where competent citizen interpreters are not available.
captures.paragraphText: Provided further, That provisions of law prohibiting or restricting the employment of aliens in the Government service shall not apply to the employment of interpreters in the Immigration and Naturalization Service (not to exceed ten permanent and such temporary employees as are required from time to time) where competent citizen interpreters are not available.
captures.paragraphBoundaryStart: Provided further, That provisions of law prohibiting or restricting the employment of aliens in the Government service shall not apply
captures.paragraphBoundaryEnd: where competent citizen interpreters are not available.

captures.needle: hospitals at Ellis Island Immigration Station
captures.start: Provided, That the Immigration and Naturalization Service shall permit the Public Health Service to use the hospitals at Ellis Island Immigration Station
captures.end: under the immigration laws and regulations shall be covered into the Treasury as miscellaneous receipts:
captures.paragraphText: Provided, That the Immigration and Naturalization Service shall permit the Public Health Service to use the hospitals at Ellis Island Immigration Station for the care of Public Health Service patients free of expense for physical upkeep, but with a charge of actual cost of fuel, light, water, telephone, and similar supplies and services, to be covered into the proper Immigration Service appropriations; and money collected by the Immigration Service on account of hospital expenses of persons detained in hospitals of the Public Health Service under the immigration laws and regulations shall be covered into the Treasury as miscellaneous receipts:
